name: Underquiet Chorus
text:
At the beginning of your end step, put a hush counter on Underquiet Chorus. Then if there are four or more hush counters on it, sacrifice it.
Whenever you cast a creature spell with mana value 6 or greater, put a hush counter on Underquiet Chorus.
When Underquiet Chorus is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, create a 0/0 green and blue Leviathan creature token with trample and ward 2 and put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is twice the number of hush counters on Underquiet Chorus.
